data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to listen to volume button press events on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It allows Flutter apps to listen for volume button press events (up, down, and capture) on both Android and iOS platforms. Developers can register a listener callback to handle these hardware button events and remove it when no longer needed.
use_when: You need to detect physical volume button presses in your app
You want to handle hardware camera capture button events on iOS 17.2+
avoid_when: You only need to play or record audio
You need complex media session management
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
Simple API with straightforward add and remove listener methods
weaknesses: Requires manual modification of the Android MainActivity class
Limited to volume and capture button events
data.setup_notes: On Android, you must extend your MainActivity with VolumeListenerActivity and remove FlutterActivity.
